reason: I'm not sending my money up front on Zain Cash to a name I've never heard of and then waiting three weeks hoping something shows up. And 21,000 in fees on a 30,000 item is a lot. For electronics and car parts I can usually find it in the local market or on an Instagram page for close to that once you add it all up.
objection: Paying the item price in advance to a brand-new page with no reviews, no track record and no friend who has used it. If they disappear, my money is gone.
would_change_my_mind: If a friend or a page I trust had ordered through them and got their item, or if I could pay everything on delivery for my first order.
